import pandas as pd

path = "sales_data.xlsx"
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {sheet} ---")
    print("Shape:", df.shape)
    print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
    print(df.head(10).to_string())

from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = "sales_data.xlsx"
wb = load_workbook(path)
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} ---")
    print("Dimensions:", ws.dimensions, "max_row:", ws.max_row, "max_col:", ws.max_column)
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=min(ws.max_row, 12), values_only=True):
        print(row)

import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

path = "sales_data.xlsx"
z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
print("Archive entries:")
for n in z.namelist():
    print(" ", n)

ns = {
    "main": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
    "rel": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
}

# workbook -> sheets
wb = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
print("\nWorkbook sheets:")
for s in wb.findall("main:sheets/main:sheet", ns):
    print(" ", s.attrib)

# shared strings
strings = []
if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in z.namelist():
    ss = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
    for si in ss.findall("main:si", ns):
        text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
        strings.append(text)
print("\nShared strings count:", len(strings))

# sheet1 cells
sheet = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
rows = sheet.find("main:sheetData", ns)
for r in rows.findall("main:row", ns):
    vals = []
    for c in r.findall("main:c", ns):
        ref = c.attrib.get("r")
        t = c.attrib.get("t")
        v = c.find("main:v", ns)
        val = v.text if v is not None else None
        if t == "s" and val is not None:
            val = strings[int(val)]
        vals.append(f"{ref}={val!r}")
    print("ROW", r.attrib.get("r"), "|", " ".join(vals))

import zipfile
import shutil

SRC = "sales_data.xlsx"
DST = "sales_data.xlsx"
TMP = "sales_data_tmp.xlsx"

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
entries = {n: zin.read(n) for n in zin.namelist()}
zin.close()

sheet = entries["xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"].decode("utf-8")
styles = entries["xl/styles.xml"].decode("utf-8")

# --- sheet1.xml edits ---
# 1. dimension
old = 'dimension ref="A1:G10"'
new = 'dimension ref="A1:H10"'
assert sheet.count(old) == 1
sheet = sheet.replace(old, new)

# 2. column widths: add col H
old = '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/>'
new = old + '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/>'
assert sheet.count(old) == 1
sheet = sheet.replace(old, new)

# 3. header cell H1
old = '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>'
new = old + '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row>'
assert sheet.count(old) == 1
sheet = sheet.replace(old, new)

# 4. data cells H2:H9 (percent style s=3)
for r in range(2, 10):
    old = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    new = old + f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    assert sheet.count(old) == 1, f"row {r} pattern not found"
    sheet = sheet.replace(old, new)

# 5. total cell H10 (bold percent style s=4)
old = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>'
new = old + '<c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c></row>'
assert sheet.count(old) == 1
sheet = sheet.replace(old, new)

# --- styles.xml edits ---
# 1. add numFmt for percent 0.0% (one decimal, zero -> "-")
old = '<numFmts count="0"/>'
new = '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%;-0.0%;-"/></numFmts>'
assert styles.count(old) == 1
styles = styles.replace(old, new)

# 2. add cellXfs 3 (data percent) and 4 (bold percent)
old = '<cellXfs count="3">'
new = '<cellXfs count="5">'
assert styles.count(old) == 1
styles = styles.replace(old, new)
old = '</cellXfs>'
new = ('<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
       '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
       '</cellXfs>')
assert styles.count(old) == 1
styles = styles.replace(old, new)

entries["xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"] = sheet.encode("utf-8")
entries["xl/styles.xml"] = styles.encode("utf-8")

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        zout.writestr(name, data)

shutil.move(TMP, DST)
print("written", DST)

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"
z = zipfile.ZipFile("sales_data.xlsx")

# 1. XML well-formedness for all entries
for n in z.namelist():
    ET.fromstring(z.read(n))
print("All XML entries well-formed:", len(z.namelist()))

# 2. parse sheet
root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
print("dimension:", root.find(f"{NS}dimension").attrib["ref"])
print("cols:", [c.attrib for c in root.find(f"{NS}cols")])

rows = {}
for row in root.find(f"{NS}sheetData").findall(f"{NS}row"):
    r = int(row.attrib["r"])
    rows[r] = {}
    for c in row.findall(f"{NS}c"):
        ref = c.attrib["r"]
        t = c.attrib.get("t")
        f = c.find(f"{NS}f")
        v = c.find(f"{NS}v")
        val = v.text if v is not None else None
        if t == "inlineStr":
            val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in c.iter(f"{NS}t"))
        rows[r][ref] = (t, f.text if f is not None else None, val, c.attrib.get("s"))

for r in sorted(rows):
    line = []
    for col in "ABCDEFGH":
        if col + str(r) in rows[r]:
            line.append(f"{col}{r}={rows[r][col+str(r)]!r}")
    print(" | ".join(line))

# 3. independent computation check
print("\nVerification (expected values):")
ok = True
tot_c = tot_e = tot_g = 0
for r in range(2, 10):
    c = int(rows[r]["C" + str(r)][2]); d = int(rows[r]["D" + str(r)][2]); f = int(rows[r]["F" + str(r)][2])
    e = c * d; g = e - c * f; h = g / e
    assert rows[r]["E" + str(r)][1] == f"C{r}*D{r}"
    assert rows[r]["G" + str(r)][1] == f"E{r}-C{r}*F{r}"
    assert rows[r]["H" + str(r)][1] == f"G{r}/E{r}"
    assert abs(e - 0) > 0, "zero revenue -> div by zero"
    print(f"row {r}: revenue={e} profit={g} margin={h:.4f}")
    tot_c += c; tot_e += e; tot_g += g
tm = tot_g / tot_e
print(f"TOTAL: revenue={tot_e} profit={tot_g} margin={tm:.4f}")
assert rows[10]["H10"][1] == "G10/E10"
assert rows[10]["C10"][1] == "SUM(C2:C9)"
assert rows[10]["E10"][1] == "SUM(E2:E9)"
assert rows[10]["G10"][1] == "SUM(G2:G9)"
assert rows[1]["H1"][0] == "inlineStr" and rows[1]["H1"][3] == "1"
assert rows[2]["H2"][3] == "3" and rows[10]["H10"][3] == "4"
print("All formulas, references, styles, and expected values verified OK")
